author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಷ್ಟದಲಿ ಕುಗ್ಗದಿರು ಸುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಗ್ಗದಿರು
ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಹೇಗಿದೆಯೋ ಹಾಗೆ ಘಟಿಸುವುದು
ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿರೆ ಬದುಕ ಅನುಭವದ ಬೆಂಬಲದಿಂ
ನಷ್ಟ ಗಳಿಕೆಯು ಸಹಜ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t shrink in hardship, don’t swell in happiness;
as your outlook is, so things will happen;
if you shape your life with the support of experience,
loss and gain are natural, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Our attitude shapes what happens to us. Stay steady in good times and bad, learn from experience, and accept that loss and gain are both part of life.
